name: Maneuver Jammer - ATK
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's ATK capability.

61238.name: Improved Movement I · ATK
61238.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
In combat, the enemy's DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
